content:
Maya: Quick question — who grabbed the last lemon seltzer from the kitchen fridge? :eyes:
Ashwin: not me, promise. I did take someone's well-aged kombucha on Tuesday though :grimacing:
Olivia: guilty. left a Post-it apology and a cookie on the counter :cookie:
Nate: cookie bribe accepted. who's the cookie thief award going to? :trophy:
Sophie: we should make a tiny crown for the winner. craft time Friday? :crown:
Maya: tiny crown + tiny ceremony. vote now: :one: crown, :two: sash, :three: cookie crown
Ashwin: :one: for the crown (I will accept crumbs as tribute)
Olivia: :one:
Nate: :three: (cookie crown seems practical)
Sophie: :one: and i'll bring materials
deploy-bot: Reminder: Kitchen appliance check scheduled 4pm today. Please remove personal items from the toaster area. :wrench:
Maya: shoutout to @Ashwin for rescuing the stapler from under the snack shelf yesterday, legend status :clap:
Ashwin: thank you. offering bread-related favors in exchange :bread:
Olivia: plus one for Ashwin, also whoever bakes oatmeal cookies gets a year of goodwill :recipes:
Nate: i'll contribute bagels on Friday — gluten-free option included. :bagel:
Sophie: bagels and crowns. this is the meeting i was born for :raised_hands:
Maya: poll wrap — majority said crown. crown-making at 3:30pm Friday in kitchen. bring tiny decorations and enthusiasm :sparkles:
